Now, hopefully, that means by us falling into this jobs report that it's a flip back to the upside would love to see that and things that we're looking for um are you know in question here because there are things that are good for the markets and there are things that are good for uh us in terms of the fed cutting rates obviously if unemployment is rising and jobs dat is looking like then it then it's very conducive for the Fed to cut rates.
